issues.what: Father's red prayer found under the shoulder of the blue top, but Fatou cut and sewed that top herself in ch3; he never touched it (ch9 repeats it)
issues.quote: There, under the new shoulder seam she had sewn three times over, an older line showed.

issues.what: Fatou's mother died when she was nine; ch2 says twelve
issues.quote: Her mother had died when Fatou was nine

issues.what: Ch4 ends with a text offering triple pay to measure Lamine; ch6 then has Pape make the same offer in person as if new, and the loss to Lamine in ch5 is never set up
issues.quote: Come tomorrow to measure Lamine Ndour. Pape will pay triple.

issues.what: Chest measured 142 in ch1, 139 in ch3; tape reached in one pull in ch1
issues.quote: One hundred thirty nine," she said.

issues.what: Pape says Fatou has been paying the interest, but she did not know the debt existed
issues.quote: You have been paying interest only, little by little, yes?

issues.what: Laamb bouts are fought in the ngemb loincloth, not training trousers; the national arena is open-air, no metal roof
issues.quote: Underneath he wore the white training trousers

issues.what: Chapter titles lag the content: ch2 'Thursday Fitting' is the beach fitting, ch3 'Basted Muslin' is the first fight, ch5 'Triple Pay' is the night of sewing, ch10 'Pape's Note' (note is in ch9); ch1 title reads like brief text
'salt and shea' smell repeated in five chapters; 'voice low, scraped thin', 'gulls argued over fish guts', 'heart knocked', 'sat down hard' repeated
issues.quote: she could smell salt and shea and the iron heat
After he gone, she lifted the pedal machine cover
" Babacar. Let me open the door. Inside."

issues.what: Marabout selling 'photocopied prayers' edges toward mocking a practice the brief says not to mock
issues.quote: the marabout selling photocopied prayers in plastic sleeves

fix: Ch8-9: make the red prayer sit in facing strips cut from her father's lining roll. Ch8 mother died at twelve. Ch4 end: Pape texts the Lamine fight, not the measuring offer. Ch3 chest 142. Ch6 father paid the interest. Ch10 ngemb, no roof. Ch7 remove the real singer. Retitle ch1,2,3,5,6,8,10. Trim repeated phrases.
praise: The tailor-shop slow burn told through fittings and seams is warm and grounded, and Fatou listening to the fight through the stadium wall is a great scene.

issues.what: Ch2 repeats ch1's stop-drill-kneel-listen-to-the-ice scene as if new, with the same creak and a reworded version of Kadri's line about the ice talking
issues.quote: People think silent means strong. It is the talking that means it holds.
The conversation neither of them planned arrived without announcement.

issues.what: Kadri quoting the mother reads as Kadri having a daughter in Stockholm
issues.quote: My daughter in Stockholm records the symphony.

issues.what: Parnu should be Pärnu (ch1 and ch2)
issues.quote: a house in Parnu with a balcony
Annika understood the question was not about geography.

issues.what: The romance stays very faint for a two-chapter romance; elbows touching is the peak

fix: Ch2: turn the second ice-drilling into a thaw reading (thinner ice, a different sound) that points back to ch1; replace the brief-text sentence; cut the stated subtext. Ch1: put the mother's brag in quotes. Pärnu spelling in both chapters.
praise: Spare, sound-first prose; the ice creaking under Annika's ear and her mother's voice on Roosi's cassette land exactly as the brief wanted.
